name: Romans
tagline: Short bible talks for each Chapter of Romans

headings.name: 1. Yahweh God is the ultimate Judge of Men

columns.title: What make’s God’s Judgement unique?
columns.text: :::p:0: It is based on truth and righteousness. Rom 2:2 Rom 2:5

columns.title: When is God’s Judgement?
columns.text: :::p:0: Continuing from the last verse in chapter 1 it is those who: :::p:0: • know the righteous judgement of God :::p:0: • practise things deserving of death :::p:0: • approve of some who do the same :::p:0: • yet judge others who practise such things Rom 1:32 :::p:0: This description fits some scribes and Pharisees whom Jesus judged: :::p:0: • Sitting in Moses’ seat but do not do what they teach Mat 23:2-3 :::p:0: • Laying heavy burdens on others which they do not carry themselves Mat 23:4 :::p:0: • Neglecting Justice Mercy and Faith Mat 23:23 :::p:0: • Full of extortion and self-indulgence Mat 23:25 :::p:7: • Serpents, brood of vipers, destined for hell Mat 23:33 :::p:0: Today, this might apply to some religious leaders, politicians, business corporations, mainstream media and fake news. They deceive, mislead, are hypocrites, take advantage of others and lead them away from God’s righteous ways. :::p:0: Paul told Timothy that “All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for: :::p:0: • doctrine, :::p:0: • reproof, (the exposure of error) :::p:0: • correction, (restoring a believer to right standing again) :::p:7: • for instruction in righteousness The purpose is, “that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.” 2Ti 3:16-17 You may notice that ‘reproof’ and ‘correction’ actually need some form of judging behaviour, so how do we reconcile that with, “Why do you judge your brother? Or why do you show contempt for your brother? For we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.”? Rom 14:10

columns.title: What happens next?
columns.text: After Jesus delivers the kingdom to His Father, there will be a great and high mountain, the great city, the holy Jerusalem, with the glory of God. Rev 21:2-3 The nations, of the saved, shall walk in its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory and honour into it. Rev 21:24 (From the beginning, God’s plan has always been to save all nations from eternal condemnation.) Nothing shall enter the City that defiles, or causes an abomination or a lie, only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.  Rev 21:27 It is only through the ‘Lamb who was slain and rose from the grave’ that Mankind will be given eternal life. Eternal condemnation awaits those who were not saved. Jhn 3:36

columns.title: Judging One Another
columns.text: On the day of Judgement, the Jesus the Messiah will judge every human being. This type of judgement is for God and God alone. We are not to judge if anyone is going to be saved or not. However, Paul also gives instructions about people’s behaviour and the appropriate procedures, motivations and actions. :::p:3: 1Ti 5:19-20 :::p:3: 19 Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses. :::p:7: 20 But those elders who are sinning you are to reprove before everyone, so that the others may take warning. :::p:3: :::p:3: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, :::p:3: I give you this charge: :::p:0: 2Ti 4:2-3 2 Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage :::p:3: — with great patience and careful instruction. 3 For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear. This is not the place to teach about judging sin in others. There is plenty of teaching in the Torah and the New Testament if you follow Paul’s charge. ‘Preach the Word of God’ and be ready to correct and rebuke' But remember, only do it to it to encourage with love in your heart. Check that there is no Judgement in your thoughts before opening your mouth; it many not be appropriate for you to speak or the right moment for them to hear.
